available_at: Always null; source claims and capture chronology do not prove historical availability.
session_date: Dated crawl ledger, anchored to December 31, 2019; body M/D is cross-checked. Delivery-contract year never determines session year.
revision_identity: SHA256(source_post_id + newline + SHA256(extracted visible source body UTF-8)).
extraction: Only A/B plan branches; each ambiguous branch yields no numeric rows, with raw text and issues retained. Other valid branches remain.
ranges: Singular labels with two endpoints denote zones; low/high are numeric bounds even when source endpoints descend. Lowercase-plural labels, e.g. PBTs and GAPs, denote ordered point sequences. A singular label followed by three or more full prices (each at least three digits) is an explicit point sequence with a warning; abbreviated singular multi-price sequences are refused. Abbreviated two-endpoint suffixes retain the leading digits of the preceding full price.
price_outlier_warning: A source point more than max(500 points, 10% of the post median) from the median is flagged, never corrected.
missingness: No interpolation. Zero extracted levels does not mean zero source targets. Missing date coverage means no post was observed, not proof that none was ever published.
source_certainty: HTML/Atom agreement, metadata claims, parse success and historical availability are separate qualifications.
source_plan_branch: Plan letters are source labels, not fixed economic sides: A can be bearish and B bullish. A uniquely labelled source branch maps to bullish only from exactly one above direction paired with buy, be a buyer or become a buyer, or bearish from exactly one below direction paired with sell, be a seller or become a seller; contradictory explicit bullish/bearish confirmation wording also causes refusal. Duplicated letters, missing or inconsistent direction/action and multiple branches describing one side remain text/issues without invented numeric assignments. levels.source_plan_branch retains A/B; outlooks and daily_summary retain source_plan_a_text/source_plan_b_text and bullish_source_plan_branch/bearish_source_plan_branch. Side-specific scenario and target columns follow the economic direction, not alphabetical position.
label_formats: The exact observed mixed-case labels PrevATH and YVAl are retained with explicit source-spelling warnings; no generic case normalization is performed. Original source labels are retained. Supported syntax includes mixed-case Soc/SoC compounds (including FOMC Soc and YPOC-FOMC Soc), Roll-GAP, HVE-1yrPOC, HVE_PBT, nonstandard ONl and explicit postfix support/resistance/magnet labels. A full price immediately followed by HVE and an explicit price can delimit two labelled levels, retaining its source spelling with a warning. Explicit plural labels can introduce full point prices joined by and. Unlabelled numeric prices and singular-labelled conjunctions remain unsupported.
lis_label_modifier: The observed LIS modifier followed by one of HVE, YVAH, YVAL, YPOC, YHOD, YLOD, ATH, LVN, POC, HVE YVAH, HVE YVAL, YVAL HVE, YLOD HVE, YPOC-HVE, YVAL-HVE, HVE-YPOC, HVE-YVAL, ON-HVE, ON-POC, ON-VAH, ON-VAL, YHOD-HVE, YHOD-YVAH, YVAH-HVE, HVE-YVAH, YLOD-HVE, YHOD HVE, YPOC HVE or LVN YVAH and one explicit price or supported zone is retained as one compound source label; no extra unpriced level is inferred. The observed reversed modifier HVE LIS also shares one explicit price and remains one source label. Bare LIS followed by a price is itself an explicit source label. Parenthesized (VAR) remains a nonnumeric annotation to the priced source level. A standalone SOC: definition paragraph terminates plan branch extraction; full body text stays retained.
source_market_limit_labels: The exact source labels RTH Limit Down and RTH limit followed by explicit prices are retained as labelled source-level targets with source_market_limit_claim warnings. These are source observations; no exchange limit calculation, validity, availability or execution eligibility is independently established.
slash_point_lists: Explicit plural labels may introduce slash-separated full numeric prices, e.g. PBTs 4448/4454. Each price is a separate ordered point, with the original group text and slash_separated_plural_points warning. Singular slash lists and abbreviated slash prices remain unsupported. Any otherwise unassigned uppercase source level label causes branch refusal rather than silently omitting a level with no numeric price.
branch_boundaries: A/B branches end at the next labelled branch, Note/Reminder/Tips/Basics/Quotes/Notice headings, Rollover week/note/starts, Expiration Week, When VIX climbs above or FOMC days are paragraph opening, Today's Economic Calendar, Disclaimer, Questions, Glossary of terms, Market Movers or Follow heading. The full source body remains retained.
operative_contract_policy: An affirmative statement quoting another contract today conflicts with the header; preserve the post and both branches as text but refuse numeric extraction.
ambiguous_contract_policy: A future-tense quote of another contract justified by an affirmative present-volume-is-greater statement, without a conditional future term or explicit today, leaves the plan's operative contract ambiguous. Preserve the heading, quote and both branches but refuse numeric extraction with operative_contract_assignment_ambiguous; do not label the future-tense statement as a verified today claim.
intraday_contract_switch_policy: A past-tense I started quoting another contract after NYSE Opening Bell contradicts the retained source heading: both branches stay as text, with numeric extraction refused as past_contract_switch_header_conflict. An explicit future opening-bell switch (including preposed after the bell, future-tense since NYSE opening bell, and new /ESH20 after the Opening Bell) does not establish that contract as active in the captured plan: retain heading-based numeric extraction and future_intraday_contract_switch warning. Present I start quoting another contract, either as its month increases to equal volume or without a conditional future qualifier, leaves the transition phase ambiguous: refuse numeric extraction as operative_contract_assignment_ambiguous. None of these statements verifies pre-open availability or an execution timestamp.
target_clause_spelling: The observed joined delimiter towardsHVE followed by an explicit HVE price is recognized without changing source branch text; nonstandard_target_delimiter records the source spelling. Other joined target delimiters receive no inferred whitespace repair.
decimal_zone_suffix: A singular two-endpoint zone with a full integer anchor and a two-digit decimal suffix retains the anchor's leading digits: 4187-86.50 becomes bounds 4186.50 and 4187.00, with an abbreviated_decimal_zone warning. Decimal anchors, one-digit decimal suffixes and plural/multi-price decimal abbreviations remain unsupported.
2019_source_annotations: The exact mixed-case source label HVE Tariffs SoC followed by an explicit price remains one source label, with a nonstandard_source_label warning. The exact parenthesized ETH annotation between a label and explicit price stays in source_text with a source_level_session_qualifier warning; no independent session eligibility is inferred. A trigger consisting of exactly one full numeric price is retained as a point with source_label null and an unlabelled_trigger_price warning. Bare numeric ranges/lists, unpriced source labels and singular-labelled target conjunctions remain unsupported. No label or price is borrowed from the opposite branch.
unlabelled_trigger_price: Only a trigger consisting of exactly one full 3–6-digit numeric point with an optional one- or two-digit decimal part may have source_label null. source_text is the exact source point, notation is point, and price_low equals price_high equals that literal price. The corresponding explicit unlabelled_trigger_price issue is required. Numeric target rows still require a source label; bare trigger zones/lists or other unassigned numeric text are refused. Validation cross-checks the null-label trigger against the parent scenario and exact bounds, and only a separate compatibility projection receives a temporary marker for the frozen relationship validator. Saved tables and summaries retain the null label without an inferred source label.
contract_year_policy: January–October dated 2019 requires delivery year 2019; November–December may use 2019 or 2020, preserving the stated contract. Conflicts remain raw with numeric extraction refused.
